page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn1ne.8xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 architecture, utilizing Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processors running at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or GPU hardware, relying entirely on network-attached storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 6 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates a clear performance trade-off between single-core and multi-core operations. Single-core performance is relatively weak, as shown by a stress-ng single-core score of 1107.49 and a Geekbench single-core score of 963.0, both falling into the bottom 25% tier. However, the 32 dedicated cores deliver average multi-core performance, with a stress-ng multi-core score of 23528.93 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 8384.0. Memory bandwidth benchmarks show average throughput, reaching 92.61 GB/sec for large block read-only operations and 43.13 GB/sec for large block write operations.

Given its hardware profile, this instance is suited for multi-threaded workloads that can leverage its 32 dedicated cores, such as software compilation, multi-threaded decompression, and static web serving. It is less optimal for single-threaded tasks or memory-intensive applications due to its lower RAM-to-CPU ratio and weak single-core performance. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the instance provides a dense allocation of dedicated physical cores for parallel processing tasks without the added cost of bundled local storage or GPU accelerators.
